description: This source file is the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named 'EditMCQ'. It manages user interactions for selecting courses by semester, handling navigation buttons, and session management for an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks (home, profile, leaderboard, logout), dropdown list changes for semester and course selection, and search functionality.
